outcome.Summary: Implemented cmd/report: run() parses --by/--top flags, reads the CSV with encoding/csv, validates required columns (error names the missing column) and qty/price values (error names the 1-based file line, header = line 1), aggregates in integer cents, prints groups sorted by revenue descending (ties by name ascending) with the example's exact format, plus a TOTAL line over all rows. main calls run(os.Args[1:], os.Stdin, os.Stdout) and exits 1 with the error on stderr. Added 15 tests in cmd/report/main_test.go covering grouping, top-N, ties, shuffled/extra columns, missing columns, bad values with line numbers, flag errors, and cent formatting. Verified `go vet ./... && go test ./...` passes and the example input reproduces the expected output.
